assets.title: Flags of the war years
assets.what: The systems' pictures: each country's own flag of the war years (71 flags)
assets.author: Wikimedia Commons contributors; each file's page, author and SHA-1 are in art/FLAGS.md
assets.licence: Public domain (each file's grounds in art/FLAGS.md)
assets.changes: The PNG Commons renders from each SVG, fitted into 35 x 27 at its own proportions (the Baltic States: Estonia's, Latvia's and Lithuania's side by side), a little toned to the paper, edged in ink, on a 37 x 37 clear square; and each system's Encyclopedia plate (art/planets/, 400 x 200), the same flag fitted into 240 x 128 on the look's paper, in the plates' frame. On 2026-10-04, 83 Encyclopedia cards in art/planets were redrawn with OpenAI ImageGen in vintage 1940s comic style, preserving existing flag designs, proportions, frame, captions and parchment outside the flags. Burma, Ceylon, Malta, Kazakhstan and Indochina now use the five approved 1939 replacements, with separate source and licence entries. Original 37 x 37 system sprites remain unchanged. Original backups, generation/source manifests and 1600 x 800 masters: art/planets/vintage-1940s-comic-masters-2026-10-04; see art/FLAGS.md.
